verdict.rationale: The stated constraints do not define a required lunch duration, airport-arrival buffer, or tradeoff between fare and convenience. B is a nonstop with the earliest return arrival but the tightest lunch margin; C is a nonstop with substantially more margin but costs more; A is cheaper and leaves the most time after the program but adds a connection; D is the lowest-priced option and can still permit a brief lunch, though it is less convenient. No option clearly dominates across these unresolved tradeoffs.
